doubts.claim_under_doubt: Every terminal resolved iterate context selects the artifact-backed OperationCard even when the legacy run join has not caught up.
doubts.disproof_attempt: The server treats both done and launch_failed as terminal, but the client repair covered only done, leaving launch_failed to render OperationLive when the legacy join is empty.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Use the same terminal-state predicate as the server and cover launch_failed with a null run-detail join.
